title: Quantum Learning Laboratory
subtitle: Learn how quantum algorithms work by experimenting with them.
route_note: Chapter numbers describe a recommended route. Access to assessed work is decided by demonstrated prerequisite skills, not by a chapter counter.

chapters.title: One qubit: from states to interference
chapters.outcome: Read a one-qubit state, turn amplitudes into probabilities, apply X, H and Z, and explain how a relative sign decides what a later H does.
subtopic_titles: 1.1 Bits, qubits, and the computational basis
1.4 Read a circuit and use the X gate
1.6 Z, relative phase, and global phase
1.7 Interference: why H-H and H-Z-H differ
1.8 Build, explain, and revisit the mystery
chapters.demonstration: Predict, construct, and explain a short one-qubit circuit.

chapters.title: Geometry and measurement bases
chapters.outcome: Place a qubit state on the Bloch sphere, work with complex phase, and distinguish states that share a Z distribution by measuring in another basis.
chapters.demonstration: Distinguish equal-Z-probability states using another basis.
